page.content:
Mrs. Wallace is the mother of Lindsey Wallace and wife of Mr. Wallace. Not much is known about her. On Halloween 1978, she hired Annie Brackett to watch over her daughter while she and her husband went out to a party.

page.overview:
Who is Mrs. Wallace?

Mrs. Wallace is the mother of Lindsey Wallace and wife of Mr. Wallace. Not much is known about her. On Halloween 1978, she hired Annie Brackett to watch over her daughter while she and her husband went out to a party.
